name: Sirocco
tale:
At that time, I was bored in Pokémon Sapphire, having done about all that I could do in the game. So I was strolling through the map, checking if there was some item I forgot or anything. Then a green Taillow appeared! I didn’t even try to weaken it, only throwing balls at her until she stayed in one.

Following pictures are coming from Pokémon Diamond, after the transfer.

name: Auvergne
tale: This is a random find too. I was a Pokémon breeder on Pokémon Diamond, other players would ask me what Pokémon they wanted and I would breed it for them. This time I was asked for a Bagon of Adamant nature and with good IVs. I happened to have a French Ditto and a Japanese Shiny female Salamence and, while I wasn’t aware of the Masuda method, it worked to give me this child.

name: Plume
tale:
A bit of time after getting Bagon, I considered for the first time Shiny Hunting. I decided to try it with Poké Radar, following the advices I could find, breaking the chain several times. While my goal was Tauros, I thought it worth to train on other Pokémon. I took my time on a Starvia chain, until the awaited Shiny Grass appeared.
The battle was easy. I didn’t weaken it, as I had nothing for this, only throwing balls at it.

Illustration from flumanog on reddit.

name: Sophia
tale:
After clearing the Pokémon League in SoulSilver, I was on the way of completing the Pokédex. I transfered a lot of Pokémon from Diamond and made eggs to have them with my ID. This Baltoy is coming from this egg session, from an English Claydol and a Ditto from the SoulSilver game.

Illustration by Xous54 on DeviantArt.

name: Benedict
tale:
It was my first game of Pokémon Black. I had completed the Pokédex with trading, little by little. At a moment, I was asked for an Adamant Deino for a trade, so I started doing eggs and the second one was a shiny one. The name comes from The Chronicles of Amber that I was re-reading at that time.
Illustration by pen-papers on tumblr.

name: Corwin
tale:
After Benedict (Deino), I decided to try again on Shiny Hunting. For this, I choose to try Masuda method on a Snivy. Back then it seemed like it lasted forever while in reality it was fast.

Illustration is deviation of RileyKitty on tumblr.

name: KEUNOTOR
tale:
I wanted to try Poké Radar once more, as I have found what looked like a good way to use it. I tried it on whatever I found in the grass until suddenly a brighter Bidoof appear, on a non-shiny grass. One Poké Ball was sufficient to catch it.

Illustration by PenAndPapers on NewGrounds.

name: Jasra
tale:
Following on Corwin, I wanted to try to get the other starter Pokémon. Brand was supposed to be the next one, as I was sure it would be a male, knowing female rate is low.
I first tried on the same game I got Corwin on, then stopped for a long time before starting again on White2, after obtaining the Shiny Charm, wanting to try it with the Masuda method. I filled my 24 boxes, getting no Shiny. I then filled my party and the penultimate one was the Shiny. Though, despite the certitude, it was a female, so she was named Jasra instead of Brand.

Illustration by SarahR_Art on Twitter.

name: Milady
reference: Milady – Musketeer: Le Sang des Chevaliers
tale:
I started playing Pokémon Blue on emulator on my phone, to occupy the 40 minutes of walking and 10 minutes of train I had to do daily. As I was leveling my Pokémon, I thought it might be more productive to do it with a game where I can find shiny Pokémon, so I started Ruby.

Quickly I start the game, choose Mudkip as a starter (I thought only later that I could reset it) and went to Route 102, and started doing encounters, leveling Mudkip.
That morning, Mudkip evolved on the way to the office. At about half of the way, Marshtomp had leveled to 31 not long ago, and I arrived under a tree, thinking it would be a nice shadowy place if I had to make a picture for a shiny. And that's exactly where the Wurmple appeared!
I placed the phone on a nearby low wall and took a photo with my PSVita (unfortunately I seem to have lost the photos), before catching the Pokémon with a single ball.

I was expecting to find it far later, as various bet were around 3000 encounters. I was kind of lost after this, not knowing what to do after that.

I named her after a character of a visual novel based on the novel of Alexandre Dumas, The Three Musketeers, as I was playing it (and reading the novel too) around this moment.

At first I didn't want to make her evolve but after obtaining a Wurmple in Legends Arceus, I tried to evolve her and kept her into Dustox.

Illustration by SombraTheWolf on DeviantArt.

name: Porthos
reference: Porthos – Musketeer: Le Sang des Chevaliers
tale:
After obtaining Milady the Wurmple, I continued the story to Rustboro City. Once the badge obtained, I thought about turning this into a Shiny Badge Quest. So that's what I've done.

Between the first and second badge, I decided to hunt on Route 116, hoping to get Skitty. Taillow was not unwanted either, as it would have been a reminiscence of my first shiny Pokémon.

While waiting for the train, I noticed that the shadow of the appearing Pokémon was a bit different, until it got revealed to be a green Taillow.

I wanted to get it with a Premier Ball but I had only one. I still tried it, thinking that if it miss, I still have plenty of Poké Balls. But the Premier Ball was enough.

Continuing with the same inspiration of the visual novel / the Three Musketeers, I named him Porthos. Though this nickname is planned for Terrakion. I guess I will have to find another one.

Illustration by PenAndPapers on NewGrouds.

name: ランプラー
tale:
During a step of the perpetual contest of ShinyHunters forum, I decided to hunt Litwick. I started on my French Black game but the step got closed before I can find it, after 3100 encounters.
Start of SHTC, I decided to hunt Litwick again, on another game.
First day: 1350 encounter without a shiny.
Second day: After getting up at 12h45, I started doing encounters absentmindly while watching TV, a documentary on tornados. Suddenly, I hear the sound of shininess I haven't heard since long (Taillow and Wurmple were caught without sound).
I rush on my phone for a picture but I am disappointed by the quality so I use my PSVita. After the mandatory photo for the SHTC, I throw a Premier Ball. Only one ball, like for Taillow and Wurmple, and it gets in. Without thinking, I pass the nickname option. I had none in mind anyway.

Illustration by rinnai-rai, reposted by curiousCantrip on tumblr.

name: Zelos
tale:
After learning that reset Rayquaza on Emerald is useless (I know, it’s with runs), I then decided to do encounters to still get a Shiny Pokémon on this game I borrowed.

I don’t remember how I choose the place, but anyway that ended up being Route 120. That hunt lasted for long as I started (and ended) some others in the meantime.

And that day I decided to hunt, read and play GPX+, all at the same time. The first encounter was an unexpected Latios. Unfortunately not shiny, I still attacked it with the Bite of my Manetric, hoping not to kill it. The HP bar dangerously moved to the red part but fortunately the poor guy survived and fleed. Next time I see him, I catch him.

So I continued my encounters until being feed up and moved to the Safari Zone, searching stars but only finding a pack of Pikachu ready to slice me into bits. Scared of these things, I was happy to go back, under the heavy rain, to my herbs, half-dead of my relentless walking.

I was listening to Seiren ~Hero of Argonauts~(of Akiko Shikata) when he appeared. My first reaction was to say the word “red” four times, like a magical incantation. The second was to get my photoshotter PSVita. Then I shot the Absol with Ultra Balls, as I had no appropriate hunting team.

I don’t count how many Balls I lost on this Pokémon, but he finally entered into one after having been paralized by the Static ability of my Manectric.

The nickname was another story, another difficulty. At first I had planed the name “Black Rose” for a female. When he appeared, the first time I checked was his gender. Male.

Unfortunately. The idea was then to give him the name of a character with blue eyes and red hair to go with his colours. After a stroll on a character listing website, I found Zelos Wilder from Tales of Symphonia. I would never have thought of him. Neither would have thought of giving his name to an Absol. Anyway. It works well with this color.

Next step: Fire-Red!

Illustration by Mions-Art on DeviantArt.

name: Seisaku
tale:
So, the day before, I found Absol, today I was continuing on FireRed.

My preferences were Ditto and Venonat.

That's on the start of the evening I found this little Venonat.

I tried to put it asleep with my Hypno but without success, being defeated before it can happen.

Karen the Charizard then stood before the blue-eyed insect, being used as a punching-ball by the Venonat while I was targetting him with balls.

I chose the Great Ball for the blue colour, the first one not managing to keep him but the second one got him just right.

Seisaku for the character of .hack//G.U. that have similar colours (violet hair and blue eyes).

Illustration by RobloxMeUwU on reddit.

name: Caine
tale:
My last Masuda! As I did the other two with this method, I wanted to do this one too.

Illustration by SarahR_Art on Twitter.

name: タリエシン
tale:
So, I wanted to try the Shiny Charm with encounters. I wanted a Mareep so I went to the Floccecy Ranch.

Illustration by USV02 on DeviantArt.

name: Cho
tale:
So I was progressing into my current hunts with my favourite activity: reading. At that moment, I was on the Harry Potter series, the end of the third volume. The television was broadcasting the show The Pretender and that was between the book and the TV, when Jarod was being saved from Lyle by his brother and Harry and Hermione saved Sirius with the help on Buck, I hear from my earphones the sound of stars and I lower my eyes on a blue Gulpin with a small gasp of surprise.

It's not my favourite Pokémon from this route. With only one Great Ball (blue fitting with Gulpin) she joins my team with the name of Cho, references of Cho Chang of Harry Potter.
I found it still while reading Harry Potter, volume 4 this time. It needed only two Net Balls to catch it.

name: Marvolo
tale:
On this day, my phone was discharged. It meant I had to do a break on my fishing on Diamond as I used my phone to count. So I hunted on HeartGold where I had the ambition to find a Shiny Pokémon in a swarm.

This day, it was a swarm of Clamperl on Route 19, but I had no way to get there. I then needed to continue the story to get there. It's near the end of the day that I started hunting, while reading Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince. I wasn't counting but in less than two hundred encounters, a starry Clamperl appeared, between Tentacools, Tentacruels and normal Clamperls. I named it in referenced of the character of Harry Potter. It was the only name I had in mind.

This Pokémon was supposed to be for the ShinysHunters' Teams Cup n°7 but it appeared during the mid-contest break where no Shiny is counted.

Illustration by GhostNinja1373 on DeviantArt.

name: Devanagari
tale:
I think I wanted a Magikarp.

In any case, I started to fish on Diamond game.

Once over 10 000 encounters, I start to be impatient. I was not used to get so far. But I kept going on, one earphone on the Nintendo DS.

This evening I was chatting with a friend while sending her games openings. After Star Ocean The Last Hope, for which I had stopped hunting, I change for Star Ocean First Evolution, moving the earphone of the Nintendo DS on the laptop. I start fishing, get the fish and see it yellow. I let out a small cry of surprise and think that I should rather have kept the earphone of the device.

Quick photo with the PSVita then I look at my bag and check on the balls. None seemed good to me. So I threw a Premium Ball, as it's my favourite, then another one, a Poké Ball (I thought it would fit with Gyarados) and then finally a Quick Ball in which he settles.

I named him Devanagari because, while reading about it online today, I thought I would name it this way would I find it today.

Illustration posted by Rodrigo Avila on Pinterest.

name: Kanbalar
tale:
The ultimate goal was to find Wingul The Revolution, the Ebon Wing.

When seeing for the first time the name of this character of Tales of Xillia, I couldn’t miss to associate it with the Pokémon Wingull and I promised to myself to name this way any Shiny Wingull I would meet.

What I didn’t envision was that I would want to hunt for a Shiny male Wingull with the only goal to give him this name.

So, after Devanagari, I wondered a few minutes wether I would hunt Litwick or male Wingull. I decided for the bird.

Six long days I did hunt, comparing this hunt to a long travel (on the back of a Rapidash named “Ion” or “Yurick” depending on the moment of the day) where the end would be the meeting of a hitchhiker named Wingul.

It was then this morning, while watching the last episode of the day of the show Malcolm in the Middle, broadcasted in the French channel M6, that a star sound got heard in the unique earphone plugged on my device. One gaze at the screen reassure me about the species. A Wingull! Thanks Undine and Sylph! But a few moments later I get delusionned by this pink symbol: ♀

Anyway, I still decide to catch it. A shiny is still a shiny.
Suddenly I regret not having any Pokémon with False Swipe with me. One Premium Ball, two Ultra Balls and two Quick Balls where needed to catch this beast.

The nickname was hard to choose. I thought of the exclamation of Milla Maxwell, “Oh! Mucus!”, that amused me. At that time I thought it would work for a Shiny that wouldn’t be my target.

For a moment I really thought of naming her this way, I even wrote it. But I found that inappropriate so I chose something else.
It was finally the name of the capitale of Auj Oule that was used for this future Pelipper.

Illustration by EggEnvironmental1763 on reddit.

name: Foselos
tale:
Needing more contests, I registered for “Bip et la carte secrète” while I was hunting Wingul, after finding Kanbalar.
I decided to find by what I feared the most: resets.
As I couldn’t do Soft Resets (in other words, using the shortcut with the buttons of the device) as my L button was broken, I needed to turn off then on again the device (also called Hard Reset).

The fossils I had were Omanyte, Aerodactyle, Shieldon, 2 Tirtouga and Archen. I removed Aerodactyle so I had only five to try.

I did plenty of resets, taking two days to alternate with some others hunts.
But this day I focused on the resets and it took only 32 resets for this little male Shieldon to appear. I named it “Foselos”, the name would have been the same for any other fossil.

name: Cymnea
tale:
After Foselos the Shieldon, new part of the secret card: the imposed place is the Giant Chasm.
I naturally get into the Crater Forest where several Pokémon are interesting to me but I feel deep inside that I will meet a Piloswine.
After 4 428 encounters, it's a Clefairy that shows herself, with a Ditto. I quickly defeat the Ditto with a Thunderbolt attack and use False-Swipe on Clefairy. She doesn't loose all the HP I expected but still get into the first and only Heal Ball I throw at her.
Small surprise: she holds a Leppa Berry.

Illustration by rosedoodle.

name: Riga
tale:
As for Kanbalar, I was looking for a male Wingull. After 5 000 encounters, I started hunting for Bip et la carte secrète, hoping for a place on the podium. Foselos came, then Cymnea. I then was looking for the last Pokémon. I arrived at 9 000 when the last place was taken.

While I do not give up this hunt, I continued with the oldest: Wingull. To maximize the odds to find a male, I took a femalle Jigglypuff with Cute Charm. I look at the ten first encounters, all males. So I continue hunting without worry, one earphone in the ear, watching Gladiator and chatting on the Shiny Hunter Canal of the chat of PokéBip and two more forums.

Suddenly, 188 encounters after starting, I hear shining. I look at the screen and see a Wingull. Rather far, I can't see the green of the wings. I think it will be a male but I see the pink symbol being displayed. Another female despite the Cute Charm.

Illustration by ghostlyscribbles on tumblr.

name: Chesedonia
reference: Chesedonia, the Center of Trade – Tales of the Abyss
tale:
A few days before the release of X and Y, despite me saying countless time that I wouldn't buy a console for these, that I would wait for another day to get one, I started to feel restless, seeing all the images, all these people talking about it. I wanted it.

One day before the release, I went to see if the second-hand 3DS I saw was still there, but not. So I haven't bought anything.

The release day passed, my obsession is calming down. I knew I would get it anyway.

And so, two days after the release, I finally buy a 2DS (black and blue) and Pokémon X to my local retailer (ouch the wallet).

At first I did not want to reset a Starter but finally I thought I would reset it 100 times, just in case. Even though I knew I would stop only when I get it.

I didn't had to go that far. 15 resets later, a little Fennekin showed itself in my party with this purple/silver colour (depending on the point of view, I see both alternatively) that prove the shininess.

name: Aria
tale:
Espurr and Meowstic are my two favourite Pokémon from X and Y. It was obvious to me to hunt for them when I get the game.

After a few tries on Route 6 before being done with the story, I finally continue with the Friend Safari where I got the code of someone having, like me, Espurrs.

This evening, I hunted Litwick while accompanying it with encounters of Espurrs and Abras that I were not counting anymore. I hoped, of course, to get Litwick before. But it was a milk-coloured Espurr that went through the screen of my 2DS.

A few pictures, a False-Swipe hit, a Premier ball, and it was done.

As it have blue eyes (or at least it seems to me), I named him “Aria”, in reference to the President of the Aria Company that is a blue-eyed white cat in Aqua / Aria.

This Pokémon won’t evolve but I’ll hunt a few more.

name: Rinaldo
tale:
At the end of Bip et la carte secrète, one Pokémon was still not found: the Pokémon of the imposed Ghost type that I have chosen to be Litwick. When it ended, I was at 9 000 encounters, approximately. But I did not want to give up on it and continued. It was more than one month after the start of the hunt that this little pest arrived, while I was watching Mr. & Mrs. Smith on the M6 channel.

I heard it appear when I had the eyes on the computer. I then turned the head toward the screen where I saw the flame being another colour before going back to the computer with a small adrenaline rush and affirm on the shiny hunting chat that I found it and get a fit of laughter.

I had to recharge my PSVita before being able to capture it, to be able to take a picture. Once done, I noticed I had only 12 Premier Ball left. One was enough to catch this little one.

name: Break
tale:
I was working on the completion of the X Pokédex, while hunting as a side. For now, I only had as a goal to get the 151 first Pokémon, excluded legendaries and non-available Pokémon.

Arrived at Nidorina, I noticed how hard it is to find Moon Stones.

Once done with the remaining Pokémon of this part of the Pokédex, I start hunting Moon Stones. With my loyal Absol False-Swiper Robber, and four Pickupers, I go for the Glittering Cave (I think it's the name) to rob poor defenseless Lunatones.

Though there I found only two Moon Stones, one on a Lunatone, the other on my Linoone (named Pikachu by the one who trade it to me).

I then got the idea that Clefairys too hold Moon Stones and that I have a Friend Safari with Clefairys. I then get out of this cursed cave and move there.

About half an hour later, I don't found any Moon Stone, but instead, it is a brown sugar Swirlix that shows itself.

A False-Swipe hit, a Luxury Ball after hesitating with a Premier Ball, and there it goes.

Named Break, referencing Xerxes Break that always have sweets.

name: Mejojo
reference: Mejojo von Garibaldi – Black Wolves Saga
tale:
After each hunted Pokémon, it's a cat's turn. Today, after Litwick, it was Meowth.

For this Pokémon, I chose Route 6 that is, in my opinion, its perfect habitat. Indeed, it finds food (Pidgey), a great body of water to drink, herb for the fur (Oddish) and nice high grass to make comfy nests.

I was looking for Meowth on FireRed while looking for Moon Stones on X. Today, Swirlix arrived while I did not want him. While I did not expected to see any Shiny, be it Meowth or not. But it was while watching TV that he arrived, Meowth. I didn't believe it when I heard the shining sound.

Illustration by ProfessorYaura.

name: Sage
tale:
Discovering Lapras in X, I promised to myself that I would someday reset it, if it's possible. I later learned that it is indeed possible and place the hunt just after Meowth.

Once Mejojo done, I start Lapras. Two days later, I decide on a nickname: Sage if male, Undine if female.

The following day, I sit at the table to scan my drawings and there he arrived.

name: Nia Khera
tale:
After Lapras, I wanted to get my cat, in other words Espurr.

So, a day and 710 encounters later, it appears, shiny, but not feline. Oddish it was, while I was watching Psych.

Illustration by ShatteredEarth on tumblr.

name: Wingul
tale: Nothing much to say. After two females, I finally got the male I wanted. I did not hope it would be that quickly after the last Shiny.

name: Osric
tale:
I was looking for a Purrloin for my Shiny cat army. I chose to hunt it on G5, first Black game, in the Dreamyard. I first hunted it with Repel, but as it bored me, I stopped the Repel.

After 6 743 Pokémon, it's a Shiny Patrat that shows itself.

name: Dalt
tale:
Today I was wanting to cover my back in case of encounter with a Shiny Geodude at the Victory Road. For this, I needed a Pokémon with Levitate and Psycho Shift, as I had no Air Balloon.

Psycho Shift can be taught to a Chimcheo with breeding with a Solosis. I look into the computer: three Solosis. An English dad and his two child. And then I notice one of the child have a red star on its profile.

name: Aramis
reference: Aramis Spring – Tales of the Abyss / Aramis – Musketeer le sang des chevaliers
tale:
During a chat starting with the Pokémon Bank and ending with the Vivillon Hunt, I got the feel to hunt my first Vivillon.

The same day, I started to hunt Scatterbug and found, in the evening of the same day, a white little Scatterbug that I quickly evolved into a Vivillon.

name: Gilbert
tale:
Some time ago, I started hunting during the Bug Catching Contest on Pokémon SoulSilver.

It was long, as I could only hunt three days per week, refusing to change the date, and I thought I missed a shiny.

Hunting with a Shiny Sceptile as False-Swiper, I couldn't put the sound on due to the number of false joy. Finally, I found a tip while putting only one of the earphone that doesn't give me the sound of the Sceptile, but only the one of the opponent Pokémon.

I hunted then today, as I couldn't hunt last Tuesday. I think I did the contest three or four times and was at 188 encounters for the day when the shining got heard.

A magnificent Volbeat!

I use False-Swipe, but the Volbeat use Protect, so I have to use False-Swipe another time and it leaves it more than 1 HP. Anyway, I throw a Sport Ball, I could still us another False-Swipe but it stayed in this first ball.

name: Amagami
tale:
I decided, one day before the Tour de Kalos, to participate.

Two days later, the Pokémon Bank is released and I start my game anew, and my participation.

It took me two weeks and one day to manage to get my first Shiny in this game.

During the first step, I resetted Chespin. It was long and Engeve didn't come.

Second step, it was Bulbasaur. Less long, but neither Ilyusha nor Lirin came after a week.

Third step, I feel dishearten, feeling like I'm cursed with resets, but it was out of question to do another one.

I hesitated for a long time between only reset Amaura or reset Amaura and Aerodactyl. I finally did the first option.

And then, while watching dance on ice, exactly 200 resets later arrive this Amaura.

I let out a small cry. One month and eight days without Shiny, knowing I hunted every day since. It was long! I informed the members on the shiny hunting chat. I got asked if it's a joke but no!

Two saves, a renaming, a few pictures, et voilà!

name: Ada
tale:
Third week of the Tour de Kalos.

And luck is with me!

As you might now, the two first week were not good for me. During this one, I found an Amaura. After listing the Amaura, I decided to research in priority Pokémon from Kalos and decided to go for Helioptile.

Moving to Route 9 for this, it was on the back of my MoonWalker Rhyhorn that I was doing encounters with a Illuminating Staryu.

I was reading Howl’s Moving Castle and decided for “Percival” for a nickname for the Helioptile but looked for other nicknamed for the other Pokémon just in case I would get an “unwanted” Shiny. Despite my precautions, I managed to find only one nickname: “Ada”, for an Hippopotas (Thanks to Suisen).

It was this evening, while I was watching Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets that this unexpected guest shows herself. Thanks to Ada, I had the opportunity to try the False-Swiper Celebi and the conclusion is that a few more levels would be good.

While waiting for the end of the step, I continue looking for Percival.

name: Saphir
tale:
Fourth week of Tour de Kalos.

I planned to hunt Dedenne.

I took a bit of time to equip myself correctly, with a lot of balls – I would have wanted Luxury Balls for Dedenne but I couldn't get some – and a Pokémon with Static to find more Dedenne.

I have planned to call it Dist, if it was a male, due to some fan's images I really like. I still planned in case it's a female to call her Saphir – reference to some stories with Dist.

Through the week, I thought I would find another Pokémon: Starvia, Nidorino, Nidoran ♂…

But today I got lucky!

A small adrenaline rush when I see the chocolate colour of Dedenne but a bit disappointed when seeing the ♀ symbol. Anyway!

Though she was hard to catch. Celebi was still not at a good level and is a bad False-Swiper. I hope it'll be better later. In the worst case I still have an Absol.

name: Hikaru
tale:
More than one month without Shiny. I never had such a big gap.

Between the step of Tour de Kalos that went unsuccessful and the hunt of Meowth that went over 30 000 encounters, it started to be long.

Two days ago, I decided to start my X game over again and to clear the League.

After improving Sage's EVs a bit, I clear the League and continue my hunt on Route 2. The goal was to get a Scatterbug to evolve it to a Monsoon pattern Vivillon.

It was around 20:15 that I hear the shining of another Pokémon than Scatterbug: the terrible Fletchling!

Adrenalin rush that I calm, with trembling hands I announce its appearance, get my PSVita, its charging cable and my phone's cable, take a picture of the 2DS with the PSVita and finally start to battle.

A hit of False-Swipe (it was not needed) and I throw a Poké Ball.

After a small search, I name her Hikaru for the character of Magic Knight Rayearth.

21 hunts left to complete!

name: Alfred
tale:
Hikaru have appeared. It was time to continue a hunt that have reached 10 000 encounters on X.

It was during Tour of Kalos that I have started hunting on Route 16, not knowing what Pokémon I wanted to find.

Finally my heart set itself on Klefki that I wanted to name Alfred in case of male, and I really wanted it to be male.

After Hikaru, I got a Magnet Puller and went in hunt.

About ten days and 19 313 finally were needed to saw it appears while, in the book I read, Harry triumphed from the first trial of the Triwizard Tournament and was listening to the bad mood of Pomfrey while being healed.

I removed my Magnetic Pull Nosepass to get my False-Swipe Absol then I hesitated on the Ball. My choice finally set on a Luxury Ball, he got inside it without issue.

20 hunts left!

name: Indignation
tale:
I hunted this Eevee to giver her as a gift to my significant other. The idea was to get her to evolve into a Jolteon.

Illustration by Mipiacedisegnare on Facebook.

name: Percival
tale:
So… During Tour de Kalos I hunted Amaura during a step and then I moved to Helioptile once I got it.

Unluckily, it was an Hippopotas that appeared. I resumed the hunt until the end of the step than resumed it again later.

Exactly eight days after Alfred the Klefki, here is a small red Helioptile that appears, thanks to a Staticing Pikachu.

A male, just as I wanted.

I change Pikachu for Absol then throw a Repeat Ball with even doing False-Swipe and it get into it without issue.

Illustration by PenAndPapers on NewGrounds.

name: Ilyusha
tale:
Percival have appeared! Hurrah! Hurrah!

Right, it’s time to continue my other hunts. Ilyusha – or Lirin if female, Bulbasaur from Professor Sycamore.

I deliberatly passed this place, the obtention of this Pokémon, to hunt it later.

So two days after the finding of Percival the Helioptile, there is Ilyusha that shows his bulb.

It’s been a while I had no big reaction seeing a Shiny. For Ilyusha, I’ve let go the console (on the sofa, it didn’t fall on the floor) et let out a light “woah”.

Next step: Elza the Litleo (male).

name: Random
tale:
I was looking for Litleo (or at worst Bunnelby) for this hunt started during the first step of the contest Tour de Kalos, praying for not getting a Bidoof or a Riolu (knowing that, strangely, I would have prefered getting another Bidoof than another Riolu).

Wanting a male Litleo, I used a young Wigglytuff with Cute Charm to attract males. But it was not a Litleo but a young Azurill.

One hunt left to complete on X and 17 total!

Illustration by Astr0nautical on DeviantArt.

name: Auger
reference: Auger von Garibaldi – Black Wolves Saga
tale:
After 98 days without Shiny, this one appeared. I hunted it since beginning of January.

So far it is my longest hunt, so much it became almost legendary in the communities I was in. It lasted so long I thought I was cursed and would find a Pidgey instead, or even a female Meowth, as I was specifically looking for a male.

The capture was rather straightforward: I put it asleep with Sleep Powder and threw a Poké Ball and that was it.

name: Brand
tale: After taking the Y game of my significant other and starting a new game, I hunted a Scatterbug but it was this Pansear that crossed my road.

name: Clarissa
reference: Clarissa Handrel – The Chronicle of Amber
tale:
I have started the hunt during a thematic hunting night and then converted it into a race.

At the start, I wanted a male.

Today I hunted a Vivillon on Y and found a Pansear. Continuing, my console told me it wants energy so I changed game. Ruby on emulator. It's barely about thirty encounters later that a female Zigzagoon appears.

name: Erston
tale:
I hunt on old games! (Ok yes it's an emulator…)

I had started, long ago, a number of hunts, including Cyndaquil on Gold.

This evening, after a long day of school, I hunted while watching my significant other fight bosses on Tales of Xillia 2. I was supposed to help them but I was rather happy not doing it.

In the middle of a battle, I ask them to watch my phone: a shiny Cyndaquil!

He will evolve into Typhlosion.

Illustration by ginja_K_ninja on furaffinity.

name: Li Ying
reference: Li Ying Long Dau – Tales of Xillia
tale:
At the same time as I started Cyndaquil, I also started Chikorita on Silver (and Totodile on Crystal).

As usual, I was hunting before my lessons while doing other things (there I was playing Musketeer: le sang des chevaliers, and progressing on Pokémon X).

And suddenly, he appears!

He will evolve into Meganium.

name: Chamo
reference: Chamo / Chic / Poussi – Pocket Monsters SPECIAL
tale:
I started this hunt long ago, with a few others.

But I didn't do it for long.

I had changed the battery of the game but it quickly got empty. One or two months ago, my significant other changed the battery of their Crystal game and I asked them to change the one of my Sapphire game, as they were at it.

I resumed my Torchic hunt, yesterday, after my battery said stop" for my Litwick hunt on other consoles. And tonight, a bit of time after the advertising on TF1 channel, appears this beauty."

name: Luka
tale:
A new hunt over!

So, after Chamo the Torchic, I continues a race hunt with someone else (Kabuto VS Omanyte) where I got beaten.

With the same person, I started another race implying another of my hunt: the swarms. White VS Diamond/Pearl/Platinum.

My opponent was busy today so I was catching up on my encounters while reading my lessons and listening to music.

Today’s swarm was Pineco on Route 6 and a few Pokémon I did not want.

I had overtaken my opponent not long ago when a look at my screen shown me a Shiny Pineco.

As I hadn’t heard the shining, I am wondering if I didn’t miss another shinies. Anyway. I asked someone if the shiny colour of Pineco was the one I seeing, just to be sure.

A hit of False-Swipe, a Timer Ball, and there it was. Now the hardest: find a name. Yoshimoto came to mind but… No. I came back to my computer and a music came to the player: “Ray – Recall”, ending of the anime AMNESIA. So why not “Luka”? It’s a character of AMNESIA CROWD. And so it got named Luka.

Next hunt: Turtwig on Pearl, racing with a Treecko on OR/AS

name: Mist
tale:
I compelted Omega Ruby today. The league yesterday and the Delta Episode today.

So I returned to hunting while reading the most boring thing I have: lessons. About European Union.

I barely have started the second (or third) page of the chapter 6 that he appeared on the screen: the sign that my 18th current hunt is over, Mist the pretty boy!

name: Rita
tale:
It was for a contest that I have started hunting Eevee. Or rather, a big race. The race was completed quicky without a result for me. Though, I don't give up, and decided to continue.

The planned nicknamed was these: Rita if female that would evolve into Flareon, Rochefort if male that wouldn't evolve.

Of course, knowing the rate of a female, I was sure I would get a male.

I hunted for a long time, taking breaks for this or that. And as usual, I prefered hunting while doing other things on the side.

I went pass 10 000 Pokémon seen while I was at school. I had the number of resets in memory in my phone. Then during the Made in Asia, I lost my phone, that ended in the pocket of someone else, as it was not found. Without the exact number of Pokémon seen, I decided to resume at 10 000 Pokémon seen.

Today, I have decided to play at Hakuoki while hunting, hoping to complete the game without going to sleep at 2 in the morning, like the previous night.

I was on the route of Okita… And I check the 5 Pokémon I took. I pass quickly and see a red star. I go back knowing that it's not an illusion. A shiny!

I expressed my joy on the Shiny Hunting chat of Pokébip, being a bit sad of the emptiness it generate. Indeed, the first person reacting wasn't even aware of the Pokémon I was hunting, even though I talked about it for so long on this same chat. And no congratulations. I had to complain to get some. What a shame. Anyway.

I look at its gender and is surprised to see it being female. I was not expecting it and am even a bit disappointed about it.

I was expecting so much to get Rochefort that I wasn't thinking I could get Rita. Even though I knew she would be the hardest to get.

I quickly saved my two games (Pokémon and Hakuoki) and used one of the extra of Hakuoki to make a nice picture of my little girl. It was a moment since I wanted to try this.

For the next hunt, I don't know yet. Maybe I'll continue Litwick.

name: Deela
tale:
It was for the SBQ that I started hunting on Route 112.

I had looked what I could find there and wanted Numel. So I chose the place with the highest encounter rate.

75% Numel for 25% Machop.

Many things happened and I was needed to put this hunt on hiatus and resume it several times.

Anyway.

Three contests this summer and the Nostalgia Contest was preventing me to continue Litwick, so I first did a bit of Dialga before being (quickly) tired of it and continue Numel.

Or rather, I hoped Numel.

My significant other just left, I did a bit of cleaning, I completed the checking of my mail. I was on the way to resume my RP answer I had started.

Buuuuut… A Machop appeared.

I first heard the shining and weirdly it didn't even moved me. Even though I hadn't found any Shiny since April. I was sad when I saw Machop. I really wanted a Numel.

Anyway. I took a video for the ISHC. Then I noticed it's a female.

I had planned the nicknames! Jurt if it was a male, Deela if a female.

Start of the battle.

I looked at my Pokémon, to check if I had someone able to put it to sleep or anything.

Nothing.

Well, I just had to keep sending Balls. I chose Great Balls.

1st: Fail.

2nd: A bit longer.

3rd: Now it's good.

Now I'm probably going to continue Feebas on Diamond.

name: Koinobori
tale:
I had decided to start a long hunt: Feebas on Diamond without changing the game's time that would have kept the spot.

I probably found the Feebas spot only five or six time. Yesterday, I had found it and have started hunting on it.

Of course, today it was gone so I started to search it again.

At the same time, I played the Sims 4.

And then, the shining sound.

Gyarados!

Well, I already have a shiny Gyarados but it's still very good. And it's pretty a shiny Gyarados.

The only issue, I had no nickname for this beast. Without diminishing its HPs, I threw a Repeat Ball that got it in the first try.

Right, the nickname. The only I had was for a male. And then I remembered that Gyarados looks like a Koinobori.

So, Koinobori.

name: サイ
reference: Sai – Fragile Dreams ~Farewell Ruins of the Moon~
tale:
It's to complete the family, and continue a stupid project, that I had started a new Litwick, at the same place as the other two.

This time I hoped it wouldn't come after 20 000 encounters, like Rinaldo did.

I changed hunts a lot in the meantime, either because I was bored or for contents, like Nostalgia Contest.

Quickly, the Litwick got over 10 000 encounters and that frightened me. I didn't want another Auger and even though it was an extreme though for 10 000 encounters, it was still a possiblity.

Last evening I was sat onthe sofa, computer with GPX+ on the lap, right hand with Litwick encounters, left hand with interactions on GPX+, my eyes on the PSVita playing AMNESIA Memories in auto mode, the DS Lite in one hear, the PSVita on the other.

Suddenly, as Sawa was talking, it was the sound of shining that made me jump. I was scared that, being too focused on the PSV, I wouldn't hear the shining sound.

Photo / Video, the battle was… There was no battle in fact. I haven't weakened Litwick. Though I had troubles to choose which Bal to use. For Litwick, a Premier Ball would have been nice, it's a ball I like, but I had planed to make her evolve into Chandelure. With what I had in my bag, there was no choice: Ultra Ball.

Full life, one ball, it was done.

Next: Dialga from Sinjoh Ruins.

name: Rotelro
reference: Rotelro Bridge – Tales of the Abyss
tale:
So… I started it so long ago that I don’t remember how it started. I remember that after getting my first Vivillon, I tried to get another one on the Y game of my significant other.

This hunt ended with a Pansear.

So I started over again to get a Scatterbug. In the meantime, I gave back the Y game and continued on my own X game, that I had started over to change the pattern to Marine.

A few weeks back I thought it would be time for me to work on it and I resumed the hunt, fearing another Pokémon. Though, I got told I can get Spewpa at 100% rate on berry trees.

It took me a bit of time to get ready for hunting with berries, but once done, I could hunt regularly.

Yesterday, I was playing with my significant other at Age of Mythology. After being destroyed on the first game, we started over and it’s during the start of the game that I hear the shining sound, and for once, I almost shouted “shiny”.

The battle was quick: I had no False-Swiper so I planned to harass it of balls. Dive Ball. One was enough!

After getting the photos and videos, I gave it a Rare Candy and Rotelro became a pretty Vivillon!

name: Calcifer
tale:
When I started Pokémon X over the last time, I choose Charmander without taking it, to reset it later.

As I planned to start the game over again, I decided to put these resets in my hunt alternance.

So I was gone for 1000 resets.

Today, exactly six day after starting, I noticed the red star on my Pokémon, while I was waiting for my computer to restart after a freeze.

name: Soji
tale:
This hunt have been started long ago. I had in mind to reset Suicune on FireRed and, after that, to hunt the other starters and the roaming legendary associated. The only issue, the Charmander of this game was not shiny.

So I decided to hunt Charmander and only him on LeafGreen, so I would get the three starters at the end of the project.

Of this hunt, I progressed a lot without counting. In the end, what I have not counted must be higher than what I have coounted.

Finally, I decided to hunt a bit at work, as I was alone. It's then that he appeared.

name: Lastalia
tale:
This hunt was my very first hunt. I wanted, at a moment in time, find a Shiny Swablu on my Sapphire game. I did it at the same time as Zangoose eggs. Though I never went very far on this.

It’s only recently that I decided to resume this hunt with the intent to complete it, because, after all, I don’t like giving up. After a bit of researches, to maximise my chances to get Swablu, I decided to use a level 17 Repellent.

First step: obtain a Smoke Ball to be able to run away more easily. The only issue is that it have 5% of chances to be hold by a Koffing at 2% encounter race. It took me a few days before finding one.

Obtaining a repelling Pokémon was far easier, a level 17 Swablu was enough, holding the previously obtained Smoke Ball.

With a Repel and the Acro Bike to jump in the herb without using the Repel, I started my hunt.

It was a long hunt, I never thought it would be that long to make encounters with a Repel.

After 4 362 encounters, it was not a Swablu that appeared but a Seviper!

I look at my team to battle it, it seems very unwell. I wonder what happened for it to be like this. I call Nincada that, I know, haven’t learned False-Swipe yet, but it’s okay. I throw a Great Ball, only one, and she got in it.

The hardest was to find a nickname. For a male, I would have found one without issue, but for a female it’s different.

Finally I called her “Lastalia”, as I was playing Tales of Graces f when she appeared.

Illustration by pen-papers on tumblr.

name: Faiella
tale:
When I do a game's adventure, I never have luck with shinies, I never find any randomly.

As for Sun, it was starting the same. Would it have not been for my decision to complete the Pokédex a bit before ending the game.

At this moment I was at Malie Garden under the rain, praying to get a Castform or a Politoed.

Unfortunately these Pokémon appears in S.O.S. and I was aware it improves the shiny apparition rate.

I was against Cottonee, defeating the caller every time it called a new Pokémon to prevent it to kill itself and ends the battle. I had a few Poliwhirl, a lot of Cottonee, then I put my game into sleep mode as the current Cottonee calls for help.

Food break.

I come back, awake my console. Oh, a shiny Cottonee. My only reaction was a sigh. It was a bit my fear to find a shiny with this method as I prefer getting full rate shinies.

Though I don't say no to a Shiny. I defeated the other Pokémon before trying to catch this one. Not knowing which Ball to use, I chose the Premier Ball.

name: Marta
reference: Marta Lualdi – Tales of Symphonia Dawn of the New World
tale:
This time, I was looking for a Relicanth while fishing to complete the Pokédex.

At 1% encounter rate, it takes a lot of time to find one, as Magikarps appears often.

And then at a moment, a yellow Magikarp appeared.

I haven't seen the stars but I had no use of it. I didn't know in which ball to put it so I chose a Poké Ball.

One and it was over.

name: Kunzite
tale:
My goal, it was a Kommo-o. I needed then to find a Jangmo-o and make it call another Pokémon.

I already had a very long battle where no Kommo-o wanted to come and I unfortunately killed the other one.

So while I was looking for a Jangmo-o, a Carbink appeared, of a different color.

Two Shinies in two days.

What is funny, is that at the same time I was wondering what colour it have in Shiny.

name: Oberon
tale:
This time, I was looking for a King's Rock. On Slowbros.

So I had found a Slowpoke and was waiting for it to call Slowbros.

Of course, my fear was to find a S.O.S. Shiny with lower rate. Well, that happened!

name: Phoebe
tale:
Castform doesn't exist, it's a legend.

It's on this state that I was looking for it to complete the Pokédex.

This Pokémon can only appears on S.O.S. encounters so I did some on Exeggutor Island on Exeggcute.

And it appeared. The Shiny Exeggcute.

I did no photo nor video.

Though the next day, Castform appeared to prove it's not a legend!

name: Engeve
tale:
It was a hunt I have started long ago, even before Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire got released.

After Fennekin arriving that quickly, I had no hope it would appears rapidly.

But there, I needed a lot of patience, so much that I stopped counting for a moment.

And that’s today that it finally arrived!

While I usually have very few reactions, I’ve let a big “OH” when I saw it.

Next Hunt: Kabuto!

name: Vicalle
reference: Old Vicalle Mine – Tales of Xillia
tale: Illustration by Retratosanime on ArtStation.

name: Pika
tale: Illustration by Joana-the-Raichu on DeviantArt.

name: Sekundes
tale:
I started this hunt knowing it would be very long.

Sinjoh Ruins resets, with the cutscene takes over 3 minutes to be done.

Also, many told me this Pokémon can't be shiny, that the eggs from Sinjoh Ruins are Shiny Lock. I didn't want to believe it so I went on it.

Well, now that it's there, I guess some would still don't believe it, thinking I used a cheat. Not that it matters much to me.

Illustration by cry4nne on tumblr.

name: Harla
tale: Illustration by PenAndPapers on NewGrounds.

name: TORTIPOUSS
tale: I have started this hunt long ago. While I keep no trace of it, I know I have completed it, but the game is stuck in a box until house moving.

name: Marie
tale: I have no recollection of her besides this picture and a note on her capture. I don't even remember why I named her Marie.

name: Nido-chan
tale:
I have noted the meeting of a Shiny Mankey that I had run and it intrigued me greatly. In what circumstances have I met this Mankey?

This stayed a mystery until I found my LeafGreen game and turned it on: there I see a shiny Nidoran I have totally forgotten about.

I found traces of the encounter on my old Twitter account, thus giving me at least the encounter date.

name: Mithos
tale:
I started to hunt in commute as a way to busy my hands while reading. I just took the first game I found and it turned out to be Silver.

But this evening it was at home while watching TV.

He was not weakened before being caught. He got caught in 3 Pokeballs.

Strangely, a few days ago, I dreamt of finding a shiny Rattata. Though it looked more yellow in my dream. If I had no sound I would probably not noticed it's shiny.

name: Strohl
tale:
So, after Rattata, I continued hunting on the next road before thinking I did not want another Rattata, and in fact would prefer a Ledyba. So as it was night, I decided to go to the Dark Cave instead, with the hope of finding a Dunsparce.

I had caught a Bellsprout to get Sleep Powder to make the capture easier and put it to good use when the Geodude appeared. Then, it took 3 Poké Balls to get it caught.

As the previous Pokémon, would I not have the sound, I wouldn't have noticed it's shiny.

name: Kinta
tale:
This is a random find as I was wandering on Scarlet, catching Pokémon and checking where I can go with my current progress.

I was craving for a Shiny as it was 84 days of hunting since the last Shiny and nothing appeared, and seeing two Shinies appear on the game of my significant other.

It is clearly not what I expected but I still take it.

name: Lintra
tale:
Again I was just wandering around, trying to get to a place I haven't visited yet (Alfornada). I was a bit concerned because the Pokémon of the area are of a higher level than what I'm used to and close to my Pokémon levels so I decided to not do any battle there yet.

And on my way, I notice a Gible that, I think at that time, looks like a Gabite. I quickly understood it's a shiny one.

Though I made the acquisition of a False Swiper, it was about 20 level below the Gible's level so I did not use it, instead trying not to kill it with my Kilowattrel.

While I usually care about the ball I use, this time I just wanted to catch it for sure so I used a few Ultra Balls to get it.

name: Stonehenge
tale:
Since the start of the game, every mass encounters were in areas I hadn't reached yet. This one appeared on my way to the story so I thought why not give it a try.

I went at it in auto battle, knowing my kitty wouldn't kill a Shiny. But I was surprised when it did not want to battle one that didn't look different from the others.

So I stopped and looked at it for a few seconds, and at the others around. I noticed it was a bit darker in colour and so engaged the battle to find it being indeed Shiny.

name: Super Ball
tale:
Another random one. I was just running around when I saw this Great Ball rolling. I ran on it to start the battle. As I had nothing to weaken it, I started with throwing a Great Ball, as I thought it was just the obvious choice.

Then I thought it might destruct itself. I checked online if at this level it have anything like this in it's moveset and it indeed have.

Having nothing to counter that, I decided to try to get it the faster possible without caring for the ball. I threw a Ultra Ball and fortunately it went in it without much issues.

name: Kou
tale: Since I got Stonehenge I go to Mass Outbreaks regularly, to try to get a new Shiny. And this day was a successful one as I saw the little Pokémon appears in red.

name: Yasuke
tale:
Every time I see a Bisharp in Scarlet, I can't help but wonder if it's shiny, as the blades regularly have a blueish colour on my screen.

Today I was wandering around, trying to get an Umbreon for the dex completion, when I just stumbled across this blue Bisharp.

name: Rochefort
reference: Rochefort – Musketeer: Le sang des chevaliers
tale:
For my 100th Shiny I wanted to do a special hunt. Or at least to select which Pokémon will get the number 100.

It was a tough choice. Not because I had too many, but rather because none came to mind. The obvious choice would be my favourite Pokémon but pink Dragonair isn't quite to my liking. Another choice would have been to complete my very first hunt but I currently don't have my Sapphire game on hand. A shiny I like? None came to mind.

And I got told Eevee. Why not? I like Eevee. And I like shiny Eevee. I already got one that got evolved but more were planned anyway.

Fortunately my LeafGreen save were in a state where getting to Eevee wouldn't take too much time, as I was at Lavender Town with the goal to get the necessities to reset Snorlax. So I moved to Celadon City and struggled a bit to find the backdoor of the building and reach Eevee.

Not wanting to get another Pokémon being my 100th shiny, I stopped playing any other Pokémon game that was able to give me a shiny. It meant no Pokémon Sleep, and moreover no Pokémon Scarlet that I was currently playing.

It was quite hard, I really wanted to continue Pokémon Scarlet. Or even Shield, as I was watching my significant other play their game of Sword. But I hanged on.

As usual, I had the fear of having missed one during the resets. It is not difficult to imagine that this Eevee was lighter than the others, that it might have been a shiny I hadn't noticed. And as usual, all my fear disappeared when I saw the real shiny.

He appeared as I was playing the story of the last patch of Honkai Star Rail. My reaction was to say He's here!" when I saw the silver-y fur of the Pokémon. I was surprised as I thought the shiny star would be red instead of its actual yellow. I saved multiple times, renamed it, then saved multiple times again."

name: Ugo
tale:
After having completed the storyline of the main game, I decided to go for completing the dex before starting the DLCs.

My current goal was a Carkol to evolve into Coalossal.

But I was at the wrong place. I ran around and around and found no trace of Carkol or even Rolycoly. I had returned countless time on the Pokédex map to check where it can be found and I was sure I was at the right place. It seems like I can't read a map.

So while I was running around, I noticed this oddly coloured Spoink. I knew right away that it was shiny so I ran to it and started the battle.

I took a bit of time to choose the ball and decided on a Luxury Ball. I hadn't even weakened it that it settled in the first one.

Though I had no nickname for him. It took me several minutes but my mind stayed blank. So finally I thought that a driver name would be good enough and took the first one that came in mind.

name: Hellicious
tale:
I wondered for a long time whether I'll try to get Shinies from the daily Mass Encounters. I was currently not quite wanting to run around on one spot to make more Pokémon appears, since I had still more things to do in the game, and the higher chances to encounter a Shiny as I reduce the Mass Encounter made me hesitate, as I always preferred full odds hunting.

But then I decided, I'll at least try on the Gen 9 Pokémon.

So there was this Grass Type Event Mass Encounters and Capsakid. I've done a few Petilil on Kitakami before deciding not to go further for this Pokémon. But on Paldea, Capsakid would be a nice catch.

Once I've completed the story in Kitakami, I returned to Paldea, where I already had dispersed two Mass Encounters of Capsakid, and decided to disperse the remaining ones and find a Shiny if it appears.

I went to the Asado Desert where there were two and started battling the various Pokémon there. Until the game tells me the Mass Encounter is gone. I went to check the remaining Capsakid and noticed one being a little different.

No weakening, as I still have no Pokémon for that, but I took a few minutes to choose the Ball. Finally I settled on the Quick Ball as it's blue and yellow like the Pokémon. One was enough.

name: Alice
reference: Alice Alibert – Le Visiteur du Futur
tale:
It was during the main story. For the second DLC I had to return to the Area Zero. I was attentively looking around, in case of Shiny. Then I see this Scream Tail. I didn't know which colour the Shiny version is, but this one felt a bit off to me. Then another one appeared a bit further and I noticed it's the right coloured one. Obviously, this one was to be shiny.

I had nothing to weaken it without risk of killing it so I threw Heal Balls on it. It took about five for the capture to be done.

Despite being genderless, I chose to name it Alice, in reference to the movie I was watching when I met it.

name: Roman
tale:
I had spent a lot of time in the Terrarium. I don't really like the place since it features only older generations Pokémon. While it's nice for completing the Pokédex, for Shiny Pokémon I prefer those of the game's generation.

At that moment I was working on missions to unlock candies for Legendary Pokémon and I noted that with the number of Pokémon I've seen, I should have seen a Shiny. Not too long after thinking that, I climb the mountain of the Canyon Biome and notice a little white thing, understanding right away that it's a Shiny Litten.

name: Nanook
tale:
Spending a bit more time in Terrarium, this time to quickly level Dunsparce to evolve them into Dudunsparce in an attempt to get a Three Segment one.

Every Charmander I saw brought an interrogation to me: is it Shiny? This Pokémon is very bright in 3D and I thought it would be difficult to get the difference between a Shiny and the normal colour.

Then one appeared. I thought it was Shiny but was not sure. When I started the battle, it shown me I was right.

The battle was long, this little one really didn't want to stay in the ball I have selected for him.

I decided to evolve it into Charmeleon but not into Charizard, as I already have one (Soji) and a Charmander (Calcifer), and as I don't intend getting more Charmanders in this game. This way, I have the full family.

name: Sawal
tale:
I started a game of Pokémon Violet with the only intention to get its Legendaries, transfer the one exclusive to Violet into Scarlet, and trade the others away in hope to get the few Legendaries available that can't be bought directly into the games.

I had selected my team by taking the first Gen IX Pokémon I saw and that are not in my Scarlet's team, then I battled wild Pokémon to level them. Or so I tried.

Then I see a Fidough that looks a bit weird. I send my Pokémon to battle it and it refuses to fight it. A Shiny, of course. I hadn't even reached the school.

name: Sciel
tale:
When I arrived at the daycare, I knew I had to reset the egg. While the odds are of 14% of being Shiny, I still wasn't really enthusiast, as I had tried a few Togepi beforehand and that was insanely long. But this one allowed me to get the bicycle, making it go faster.

At first, I thought the odds were of 1 / 64, I was mistaking with the odds of a baby Shiny in case of one parent Shiny. When my error got fixed, I had already done 7 resets and decided to get a bit faster on it.

After 5 Igglybuff, one Elekid, one Magby, one Tyrogue, one Pichu and one Cleffa, this little girl get out of her egg, while playing at Clair Obscur.

name: Carter
tale: During my playthrough of Pokémon Shield, I came at the area of the Galar Yamask. And suddenly thought I won't continue the game without getting one.

name: Dara
tale:
Emerald always was an annoyance to me, due to the RNG issue. After a long, long time, I wondered if anyone ever thought of making a patch for it. Fortunately, I managed to find one. And with that, I decided to do Shiny Hunting, starting by Treecko.

At the start I was kind of unsure. There’s no explicit thing showing the RNG have been fixed, so I feared doing resets for nothing.

I decided, during downtime at work, to do a bit on Shiny Hunting on my phone emulator, using my cartridge saves, and alternating between each of them. After 1286 encounters on Silver (decided by the space available on one side of a sticky note), I moved to Emerald and started filling the backside of the sticky note with strokes.

Nearing the end, I noticed, from the edge of my sight, a few stars and a blue Pokémon. After over 150 hours of not finding a Shiny on Silver, I feared raising my voice too much if I were to find a Shiny at work, but fortunately I just said a surprised “Oh!”.

Finding a nickname took me a bit of time, and I finally settles for an Amber name. Now I’m moving my hunting rotation to Ruby.

name: Misao
tale:
After finding Strohl, I started hunting for a Gastly, I planned to name “Pierre”, if male, in reference to the Formula 1 driver Pierre Gasly.

Though Gastly is only appearing during the night in the Sprout Tower so I decided to go back to Route 30 in the morning for a Ledyba and Route 31 during the day for a Bellsprout.

It went long. At a moment I had in front of me a Weedle I thought might be Shiny but I was not sure and I am still not sure if it was or not.

Hours came and went, still without Shiny. I started to get discouraged and played a few other Pokémon games, hunting on some, still going back to Silver in hope to complete this hunt.

My Silver game started to get some issues. I lost my hour count a few times, so I started to count the encounters and even transfered my save on an emulator when my cartridge decided it didn’t want to keep the save anymore. Fortunately I had saved it on my computer beforehand.

So we came to these few days. I found a bit of time to do Shiny Hunting after a visit to a book store brought my attention on the cover of a book. While starting the first book, I continued on Ruby. When my note got full of counting marks, I moved to Silver while starting the second book I bought a few days after the second one.

Around 16:30, I notice my game’s time got different from real time, when going out of a battle, the screen turned blue for the night. I considered changing the time to align it with the real time but thought I’d rather not stop reading right now, I decided to move to the Sprout Tower.

Less than an hour later, a blue Gastly appeared. After a deep breath of surprise, I notice it’s unfortunately not a male and I’d have to find another nickname. But first, catching it.

Going to my bag, I notice I have only 15 Poké Balls. I changed my Pokémon for my Weepinbell, used Sleep Powder and started throwing balls. Only after the 3rd Sleep Powder and the 6th Poké Ball, she decided to give up the battle.

According to the playtime, I hunted over 160 hours for this Pokémon.

name: Hugo
tale:
That was a long hunt. I started it as part of my SBQ and expected a Solrock. Then I had a big break in Shiny Hunting before returning to it a few years later.

At first, I battle every and all Pokémon, returning to the Pokémon Center to resplenish their HP and attacks. The counter progressed. Sometimes I would change to return on a hunt on Silver. The counter progressed on both. And I got tired of battling the Pokémon, just running away when the Pokémon was not Shiny.

And the counter progressed and I was already above 10 000 encounters... And then 20 000... In the meantime I manage te retrieve my manual counter that was lost in a box.

After a moment, I wondered if my emulator was not having an issue (as I have no current meaning to change the battery of my physical game, I extracted the save and hunt on emulator), looked it up on the Internet but since I don't use the "save state" option everything should be fine. Besides, I got Dara on Emerald so there was no reason...

Thinking about work, I did encounters, my fingers automatically working on the phone screen, and I noticed right away the Zubat in the shadow that was different! Finally! While it's not a Solrock, I don't mind, I just wanted a Shiny to come out. The mechanical counter reached 5505. Well. That Zubat wasn't quite gentle! It kept going out of my Poké Balls right away! I threw about 6 or 7 on him before it finally decided to settle in it. Saving the game, it shows over 320 hours of game, knowing I lost a few unsaved hours and I started the hunt before reaching the 200 hours.

name: Antonio
tale:
Since it is not possible to reset for the starts in Scarlet and Violet, I decided to get them by eggs, doing them all three at once.

I put that hunt on hold for a few moments, only doing it when I had another side activity possible than using my Nintendo Switch (lately I usually hunt in commute while having a Visual Novel on my NSW).

So, it's the 13 June, meaning the start day of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. My attention on the race, it was a good moment to do eggs. I hatched my first batched, then continued the hunt on Sapphire while gathering the eggs for my next batch.

While hatching them, I thought of a name for a male Fuecoco: there's a driver whose name is Antonio Fuoco that always made me think of Fuecoco.

I arrived at the last box of eggs of this batch and suddenly, I notice the hatched Pokémon is a pink Fuecoco I talked about. Best of the best, it's a male.


In total 886 eggs were hatched when Antonio appeared. And 9 more Fuecoco hatched afterward.

name: Llewella
tale:
That's a hunt from long ago. So, after getting the Zubat on Ruby, I returned to it. Of course the goal was a Skarmory.

Hunting in commute, I noticed that after one hour, I've seen only two Skarmory. Okay. No shiny Skarmory for me. Anyway. At first I did battle the Pokémon but as I got busy on other things while Shiny Hunting, I stopped.

The day just before, I had a feeling that I was going to see a Shiny Sandshrew soon. And today, she appeared.

The battle was: switch for Ninjask, use False Swipe, once, twice, and then choose a Ball. I had not many: Poké, Great, Ultra, Premier, Repeat. A green one would have been nice but my choice was reduced. So I went with the Premier that is my favourite. And one was enough.

All along I wondered what name I would give to her, but then decided to look for a Chronicles of Amber name.
